name: Contains Anomalous Entities
description: You are an expert in containing and controlling anomalous entities and phenomena.
connectionOptions: One PC was once affected by an anomaly you contained.
You and one PC worked together to contain a particularly dangerous entity.
One PC is skeptical of your containment methods.

abilities.name: Anomaly Assessment
abilities.description: You are trained in identifying and assessing anomalous entities and phenomena.

abilities.name: Containment Protocol
abilities.description: You can create a basic containment field that can hold a small anomalous entity for up to 1 hour.

abilities.name: Reality Stabilization
abilities.description: You can stabilize local reality, providing an asset to all nearby allies for resisting reality-altering effects for 10 minutes.

abilities.name: Adaptive Containment
abilities.description: Your containment fields can now adapt to the specific properties of the anomaly, lasting up to 24 hours.

abilities.name: Nullification Field
abilities.description: You can create a field that nullifies minor anomalous effects within short range for 1 minute.

abilities.name: Reality Anchor
abilities.description: You can anchor an area to baseline reality, preventing most reality alterations within long range for 10 minutes.

abilities.name: Perfect Containment
abilities.description: Once per day, you can create an unbreakable containment field that can hold even the most powerful anomalies for up to 1 hour.
